task: Respond to all the emails I have received within the last 5 days (including today) that I have not replied to yet. The reply should be "I am on a vacation until 2023-05-20. I will get back to you as soon as possible.". If there are multiple people involved in a email thread, make sure to add all to the reply email. Please also mark the threads you reply to as unread and starred, so I know where to start when I get back.

emails.subject: Quarterly Team Goals
emails.body:
Hello everyone,

Attached are our team's goals for the upcoming quarter. Let's discuss these in our next meeting.

Cheers,
Katie

emails.subject: Sharing Family Recipes
emails.body:
Hi Mom and Dad,

I've been enjoying cooking lately and thought it would be nice to share and preserve our family recipes. I'll start by sharing grandma's pasta recipe. Let's keep our culinary traditions alive.

Love,
Susan

emails.subject: Updated Company Policies
emails.body:
Team,

We've updated some of our company policies. Please review the attached document and acknowledge receipt.

Best regards,
Katie

emails.subject: Client Feedback on Recent Presentation
emails.body:
Hello all,

I received feedback from our client on our recent presentation. See attached. Let's discuss improvements in our next meeting.

Best,
Katie

emails.subject: Monthly Sales Update
emails.body:
Hello team,

Please find attached the sales update for this month. Let's discuss the highlights in our upcoming team meeting.

Best,
Katie

emails.subject: Client Visit Next Week
emails.body:
Team,

We have a client visit scheduled for next Wednesday. Let's ensure our office and presentations are in top shape.

Best,
Katie

emails.subject: New Software Training
emails.body:
Team,

Training for our new software will be next week. Please confirm your availability.

Thanks,
Katie

emails.subject: Amazon Return Confirmation and Label
emails.body:
Hello Isaac Miller,

This is a confirmation that your return request for the following has been initiated.

-> 2 quantity of Innova Star Destroyer Golf Disc from order #567

Please find the return label attached herewith. You must print it and attach it to the package.
The package must be dropped off at the nearest UPS location.
We will refund you the amount of the returned product(s) in your gift card balance.

Best,
Amazon Team

emails.subject: Amazon Order Confirmation
emails.body:
Hello Isaac Miller,

Thank you for shopping with us.
This is a confirmation that your order has been placed and is on its way.
Your order number is #567.

It contains the following items.
- 2 quantity of Innova Star Destroyer Golf Disc

You can find the receipt attached to this email.

Best,
Amazon Team
